entries.description: A 6.8 m decked wooden fishing boat, green above the waterline, with a short mast and its tanned sail furled on the boom, a small cream cuddy forward, a tiller aft, two lobster pots, a fish box, a coil of rope and fenders over the side. The origin is the waterline: place it at the water's height, beside a quay.
entries.name: fishing boat

source.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_harbour.gd in the city's low-poly painted look (the city has no harbour: its water is the mill pond, the canals and the fountains)

entries.description: A red deer: wanders within its radius and grazes when idle; every second one is a buck with antlers. Flees from the player.
entries.name: deer
entries.placement: At a forest edge or meadow with room to run: they flee up to 1.5x the wander_radius (at least radius + 8 m) from home.

entries.use: scene.json creatures: {"kind": "deer", "position": [x, 0, z], "count": 3, "wander_radius": 8} (and "creatures" in manifest features)
